name: Octree-based Hierarchical Sampling
definition: A sampling technique that uses an octree to determine sampling densities for volumetric data, achieving importance sampling through different sampling densities within intersection spaces of leaf nodes and training data blocks.
summary: Octree-based Hierarchical Sampling allocates sample points proportionally to geometric overlap between octree leaves and data blocks, dynamically adapting to local granularity unlike uniform or static methods.
